name: x-outpost
note: Hard (build, long haul): a fresh 12x12 iron patch ~250 tiles from a delivery chest near spawn. Supply chest at the delivery point has drills, 350 belts, undergrounds, splitters and medium poles. Met = >= 60 ore/min arriving in the chest through its inserter, and >= 2 electric drills on the patch working on the delivery point's grid, for 2 samples.
setup_lua:
-- Shared helpers for the x-* harder scenarios (pasted at the top of each setup_lua by x-gen.py). Positions are
-- absolute; each setup picks its own origin with find_near/find_ring and adds offsets.
-- open(x, y, w, h): no water, ore or buildings in the box (trees and rocks get cleared).
-- find_near(cx, cy, w, h, rmax): the open box nearest to cx,cy (spiral search), generating chunks as needed.
-- find_ring(w, h, r0, r1): an open box between r0 and r1 tiles from the origin.
local s, f = game.surfaces.nauvis, game.forces.player
local D = defines.direction
local LAB = s.get_tile(200, 200).name == "landfill" -- the flat lab stage (448x448 landfill around spawn)
local function gen(x, y, w, h)
  local need = false
  for cx = math.floor(x / 32), math.floor((x + w) / 32) do
    for cy = math.floor(y / 32), math.floor((y + h) / 32) do
      if not s.is_chunk_generated { cx, cy } then
        s.request_to_generate_chunks({ cx * 32 + 16, cy * 32 + 16 }, 0)
        need = true
      end
    end
  end
  if need then s.force_generate_chunk_requests() end
end
local function open(x, y, w, h)
  gen(x, y, w, h)
  local a = { { x, y }, { x + w, y + h } }
  if s.count_tiles_filtered { area = a, collision_mask = "water_tile" } > 0 then return false end
  if s.count_entities_filtered { area = a, type = "resource" } > 0 then return false end
  if s.count_entities_filtered { area = a, type = "cliff" } > 0 then return false end
  return s.count_entities_filtered { area = a, invert = true,
    type = { "tree", "simple-entity", "corpse", "fish", "item-entity", "character" } } == 0
end
local function find_near(cx, cy, w, h, rmax)
  cx, cy = math.floor(cx), math.floor(cy)
  if open(cx, cy, w, h) then return cx, cy end
  for r = 4, rmax or 60, 4 do
    for i = -r, r, 4 do
      for _, p in pairs { { cx + i, cy - r }, { cx + i, cy + r }, { cx - r, cy + i }, { cx + r, cy + i } } do
        if open(p[1], p[2], w, h) then return p[1], p[2] end
      end
    end
  end
  error("no open " .. w .. "x" .. h .. " area near " .. cx .. "," .. cy)
end
local function find_ring(w, h, r0, r1)
  for r = r0, r1, 6 do
    for _, d in pairs { { 1, 0 }, { 0, 1 }, { -1, 0 }, { 0, -1 }, { 0.7, 0.7 }, { -0.7, 0.7 }, { 0.7, -0.7 },
      { -0.7, -0.7 } } do
      local x, y = math.floor(d[1] * r), math.floor(d[2] * r)
      if open(x, y, w, h) then return x, y end
    end
  end
  error("no open " .. w .. "x" .. h .. " area " .. r0 .. "-" .. r1 .. " tiles out")
end
local function clear(x, y, w, h)
  for _, e in pairs(s.find_entities_filtered { area = { { x, y }, { x + w, y + h } },
    type = { "tree", "simple-entity", "item-entity", "corpse" } }) do e.destroy() end
end
local function put(name, x, y, dir, extra)
  local spec = { name = name, position = { x, y }, direction = dir, force = f }
  for k, v in pairs(extra or {}) do spec[k] = v end
  local e = s.create_entity(spec)
  if not e then error("could not place " .. name .. " at " .. x .. "," .. y) end
  return e
end
local function source(x, y, items) -- an infinity chest that never runs out of each item in `items`
  local c = put("infinity-chest", x, y)
  for i, it in ipairs(items) do
    c.set_infinity_container_filter(i, { name = it, count = 50, mode = "exactly", index = i })
  end
  return c
end
local function sink(x, y) -- an infinity chest that deletes whatever goes in
  local c = put("infinity-chest", x, y)
  c.remove_unfiltered_items = true
  return c
end
local function grid(x, y, watts) -- an always-on power source, a corner of the main grid
  local e = put("electric-energy-interface", x, y)
  e.power_production, e.electric_buffer_size = (watts or 6000000) / 60, 10000000
  return e
end
local function gps(x, y) return math.floor(x) .. "," .. math.floor(y) end

-- x-outpost setup: a delivery point near spawn (a steel chest filled by a fast inserter from the end of a 3-tile
-- belt stub, a grid corner, and a supply chest with drills, belts, undergrounds and poles) and a fresh iron patch
-- ~250 tiles away. Met = >= 60 ore/min arriving in the chest and electric drills on the patch working on the
-- delivery point's grid.
local dx, dy
if LAB then dx, dy = find_near(-140, -4, 10, 8, 40) else dx, dy = find_ring(10, 8, 30, 140) end
clear(dx, dy, 10, 8)
local X, Y = dx + 1, dy + 1
local chest = put("steel-chest", X + 0.5, Y + 0.5)
put("fast-inserter", X + 1.5, Y + 0.5, D.east)
for x = 2, 4 do put("transport-belt", X + x + 0.5, Y + 0.5, D.west) end
grid(X + 1, Y + 3, 3000000)
local pole = put("medium-electric-pole", X + 2.5, Y + 2.5)
local supply = put("steel-chest", X + 0.5, Y + 4.5)
for name, n in pairs { ["electric-mining-drill"] = 10, ["transport-belt"] = 350, ["underground-belt"] = 20,
  ["medium-electric-pole"] = 45, ["splitter"] = 4 } do
  supply.insert { name = name, count = n }
end

-- the patch: 12x12 of iron ore ~250 tiles from the delivery point, in the first direction with open ground
local px, py
local dirs = LAB and { { 1, 0 } } or { { 1, 0 }, { 0, 1 }, { 0, -1 }, { -1, 0 }, { 0.7, 0.7 }, { 0.7, -0.7 },
  { -0.7, 0.7 }, { -0.7, -0.7 } }
for _, d in pairs(dirs) do
  local ok, x, y = pcall(find_near, X + d[1] * 250, Y + d[2] * 250, 16, 16, 40)
  if ok then px, py = x, y break end
end
if not px then error("no open ground for the ore patch") end
clear(px, py, 16, 16)
for x = px + 2, px + 13 do
  for y = py + 2, py + 13 do s.create_entity { name = "iron-ore", position = { x + 0.5, y + 0.5 }, amount = 3000 } end
end
storage.bench_outpost = { chest = chest, pole = pole, patch = { { px, py }, { px + 16, py + 16 } }, X = X, Y = Y }
return { patch = gps(px + 8, py + 8), chest = gps(X + 3, Y), supply = gps(X, Y + 4),
  dist = math.floor(math.sqrt((px + 8 - X) ^ 2 + (py + 8 - Y) ^ 2)) }

objectives.name: iron-outpost
objectives.goal: @{agent} set up an iron mine on the patch at [gps={patch}] and belt the ore back to the belt end at [gps={chest}], it feeds that chest. I want at least 60 ore a minute. Power it from the grid there; drills, belts and poles are in the chest at [gps={supply}].
objectives.answer: Your call on the route. Use the grid at the chest, no separate power out there.

score.name: ore_per_min
score.lua: local c=storage.bench_outpost.chest return c.valid and c.get_item_count('iron-ore') or 0

score.name: drills_on_grid
score.lua: local b=storage.bench_outpost local id=b.pole.valid and b.pole.electric_network_id local n=0 for _,e in pairs(s.find_entities_filtered{area=b.patch, name='electric-mining-drill'}) do if id and e.electric_network_id==id and e.status==defines.entity_status.working then n=n+1 end end return n

objectives.selftest_lua: local b=storage.bench_outpost local X,Y=b.X,b.Y local px,py=b.patch[1][1],b.patch[1][2] local p=s.create_entity{name='medium-electric-pole', position={px+8.5,py+1.5}, force='player'} for _,x in pairs{4.5,10.5} do local d=s.create_entity{name='electric-mining-drill', position={px+x,py+4.5}, direction=defines.direction.south, force='player'} s.create_entity{name='wooden-chest', position=d.drop_position, force='player'} end p.get_wire_connector(defines.wire_connector_id.pole_copper, true).connect_to(b.pole.get_wire_connector(defines.wire_connector_id.pole_copper, true), false) local src=s.create_entity{name='infinity-chest', position={X+6.5,Y+0.5}, force='player'} src.set_infinity_container_filter(1, {name='iron-ore', count=50, mode='exactly', index=1}) s.create_entity{name='fast-inserter', position={X+5.5,Y+0.5}, direction=defines.direction.east, force='player'} return p.electric_network_id
